text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: docs/module-relations.md explicitly records extraction of the incubated table modules to standalone frame4s; build.sbt has no ntab or Frame project, and docs/plans/ntab.md still sketches its own metadata/query surface. The body below is historical architecture, not an instruction to restore incubated Frame. Retain P3 deferred design only. Reactivation requires a concrete native consumer, verified current frame4s capabilities, and a bounded rewrite eliminating duplicated relational machinery before implementation. No core correctness/performance work depends on this proposal.
